meta.name: peekaboo
meta.description: Capture screenshots, inspect UI elements, drive mouse/keyboard input, and manage macOS apps and windows with the Peekaboo CLI. Use when automating macOS UI interactions, taking annotated screenshots, clicking UI elements by ID, typing text, controlling app windows, or navigating menus and Dock items.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行自动截屏、点击和操控 Mac 界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Mac 上通过命令行自动化 UI 操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate Mac UI screenshots, clicks, and input via CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate macOS UI interactions from the command line

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以截屏、识别屏幕上的按钮和文字、模拟鼠标点击和键盘输入、管理应用窗口和菜单，并自动完成这些操作。
howto.when: 当你需要自动化操作 macOS 界面，比如点击某个按钮、输入文字、截屏分析、或控制应用窗口时触发。

say.text: 帮我截取 Safari 当前页面的截图并分析。
say.note: 会执行截屏并调用视觉分析。

say.text: 在登录窗口的第三个按钮上点击，然后输入邮箱。
say.note: 会先识别界面元素，再执行点击和输入。

say.text: 打开系统偏好设置，然后点击“显示器”。
say.note: 会启动应用并模拟菜单点击。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take screenshots, identify UI elements, simulate mouse clicks and keyboard input, manage app windows and menus, and automate these actions on macOS.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to automate macOS UI interactions, such as clicking a button, typing text, taking annotated screenshots, or controlling app windows.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current Safari page and analyze it.
say_en.note: Captures screen and runs vision analysis.

say_en.text: Click the third button on the login window, then type an email.
say_en.note: Identifies elements, then clicks and types.

say_en.text: Open System Settings and click on Displays.
say_en.note: Launches app and simulates menu click.
